item: Row 291: located addresses are resolved again after a daily OSM update
summary: The located-address OSM scope signature was the extract date alone, so after a daily apply (which rebuilds the index in the same run) every memoized address kept the object it matched before, including deleted ones. It is now the country_basis index_state compares (the cut plus the daily file applied), exposed as index_state basis. A located answer carries osm_data_date from country_data_date and the address hover adds the row 286 clause (existing keys only; unchanged with no file applied). No egress, nothing stored.
